attractions.name: Mahuka
attractions.description: Through MAHUKA ("to escape" in Hawaiian), visitors are invited to enter the heart of the remains of an abandoned temple... But be careful not to provoke the God of Fire, or risk becoming a prisoner of his temple. Escape the site... escape your fears... once you're inside the attraction, there's no escaping the thrill !

attractions.name: Tiki Academy
attractions.description: Climb aboard the Tiki Academy boats , choose your water cannon and spray your friends , other boats and spectators!

attractions.name: Timber
attractions.description: The roller coaster who sending wood!

attractions.name: Mystic
attractions.description: Direction the voodoo district for a collective spellbinding 31m vertical climb! Mystic is reserved for the most daring who dare to brave the fear of heights and the voodoo spirits that inhabit them.

attractions.name: Le Totem
attractions.description: Come and test Le Totem , the immense tower with a propulsion force up to 5 times your body weight and a controlled landing on an air cushion. A real ejection seat with lightning acceleration! It's a surprising, intense attraction for those who are not afraid of the cold.

attractions.name: La Coccinelle
attractions.description: This roller coaster will delight the whole family , and your children will be able to discover their first sensations !

attractions.name: Woodstock Express
attractions.description: It's a mind-boggling ride with rapid ascents and descents, hair-raising turns and unexpected braking!

attractions.name: Le Galion
attractions.description: Are you a fan of crescendo sensations? Come aboard the pirate ship that will take you on the wildest adventures!

attractions.name: AirBoat
attractions.description: AirBoat : the best way to cross the Bayou in less than two minutes!

attractions.name: MonORail
attractions.description: Get on board now! Climb aboard the wagons for an elevated ride with an amazing view of the Explorer Adventure universe and its star attractions: Generator, Gold River and Timber!

attractions.name: Carrousel
attractions.description: A classic theme park attraction: The Carousel! You'll find this attraction immersed in the heart of New Orleans village , surrounded by giant palm trees.

attractions.name: Surf Music
attractions.description: Grab your float and face the Surf Music slide. It's time to take the plunge. Speed sensations guaranteed!

attractions.name: Volt-O-Vent
attractions.description: You'll be blown away by the winds of the American plains ... Young visitors will have to hold on tight.

attractions.name: Le Petit Vapeur
attractions.description: The miniature version of the Totem !

attractions.name: On Air
attractions.description: On board small gondolas, young and old alike can pedal away like birds in the air! It's guaranteed to make you feel refreshed!

attractions.name: Balloon Race
attractions.description: Balloon Race is a totally fun attraction to share with the whole family, or just by yourself!

attractions.name: Concert'O
attractions.description: The little ones also have their own Canadian river! Concert'O gives children a taste of their first refreshing sensations in a steampunk universe.

attractions.name: Dock'N Roll
attractions.description: Board the boat that delivers the goods to Festival City !

attractions.name: Bambooz River
attractions.description: Our canadian river Bambooz River is the perfect attraction to cool you down!

attractions.name: Les P'tits Chaudrons
attractions.description: Spin and twirl with the whole family , laughter guaranteed!

attractions.name: WAB Band Tour
attractions.description: Get on board the little train! The story of our emblematic kangaroo will be presented in several scenes.

attractions.name: La Chevauchée
attractions.description: A fantastic horseback ride on a rail circuit for little riders in search of adventure!

attractions.name: Tam Tam Aventure
attractions.description: Climb aboard the boats, let the waters carry you away and discover the flora and fauna around you!

attractions.name: Festival Station
attractions.description: Aboard the emblematic train , the whole family can discover the Walibi Rhône-Alpes park from a whole new angle.

attractions.name: Generator
attractions.description: Are you ready to have your head turned upside down, backwards and forwards ?

attractions.name: Gold River
attractions.description: Climb aboard large buoys and hurtle down the track between rapids and eddies.

attractions.name: Hurricane
attractions.description: Hurricane offers a 2-minute weightless journey. Seated on a swing , visitors will swing between thrills and giggles.
